committee_questions:L:en:
**Five questions for the Ward L committee (Kurla)**

1. **DLP recovery.** The record shows Rs 45,33,502 recoverable in Ward L, of which Rs 39,59,357 is repair work on roads still under their Defect Liability Period. WO25-02068 on Kurla Andheri Road (RD0220), paid Rs 1,97,710, is one example. What notices has the ward office sent to the original contractor, and how much has been recovered so far?

2. **Repeated repairs.** RD0220 had 35 jobs and Rs 30,52,667 spent, with 6 failed repairs. LBS Marg (RD0216) also had 35 jobs. What permanent fix or resurfacing is planned for these segments, and by when?

3. **Closed without a fix.** 52 complaints were closed as "Not BMC road" or forwarded to MMRDA/PWD, including 3 cave-in complaints on RD0220, a road where BMC spent Rs 30,52,667. Can the office confirm jurisdiction on each of these and say who now owns the repair?

4. **Never-fixed backlog.** OPEN-0130, a road cave-in on RD0220 at Kurla East, has 4 complaints (e.g. BMC25-001521) and 46 supporting votes, and is the ward's top-ranked open issue. It also serves 4 schools. What is the date for the repair, and will the DLP contractor do it?

5. **Budget.** Ward L has spent Rs 1,30,43,418 against a budget of Rs 1,19,00,000 (109.6%), and only 31.9% of jobs met their SLA. Under which head was the overspend approved, and how much of it could return through DLP recovery?

Note: these are questions to clarify, not findings of wrongdoing. Kurla is low-lying (index 0.85), and its re-open rate of 17.7% is above the modelled expectation of 0.76 only in the sense the engine reports, so the ward office should explain the context.

K/E वार्ड कार्यालय (काल्पनिक)

विषय: शिकायत क्र. BMC25-000721 पर अनुरोध

महोदय,

मैंने 18 जून 2025 को MyBMC ऐप पर मरोळ में पुलिस चौकी के पास सड़क के बड़े गड्ढे की शिकायत (BMC25-000721) दर्ज की थी।

रिकॉर्ड के अनुसार यह शिकायत "Duplicate" के रूप में बंद हुई और कार्य आदेश WO25-00282 से जुड़ी है। ठेकेदार Shivneri Construction ने वेस्टर्न एक्सप्रेस हाईवे पर कोल्ड मिक्स पैच किया। 72 घंटे के लक्ष्य के मुकाबले काम 39.5 घंटे में पूरा हुआ और 30 दिन में दोबारा नहीं खुला। इसके लिए धन्यवाद।

फिर भी इस सड़क पर 29 मरम्मत कार्यों में लगभग Rs 20.75 लाख खर्च हुए हैं और 7 कार्य विफल रहे हैं। इसलिए मेरा विनम्र अनुरोध है:

1. उस स्थान का निरीक्षण कर मरम्मत की मजबूती जाँचें।
2. बार-बार खराब होने के कारण देखकर स्थायी समाधान, जैसे पुनः सतह निर्माण, पर विचार करें।
3. कृपया 30 जून 2025 तक मुझे उत्तर दें।

सधन्यवाद,
[Name]
[Phone]
citizen_letter:BMC25-000721:en:
**Subject: Complaint BMC25-000721, Western Express Highway, Marol**

To,
The Assistant Commissioner, K/E Ward Office

Respected Sir/Madam,

On 18 June 2025, I reported a large pothole near the police chowky in Marol through the MyBMC App (complaint BMC25-000721).

The record shows that work order WO25-00282 was given to Shivneri Construction, who patched the spot with cold mix on 20 June 2025. This took 39.5 hours against the 72-hour target, so the target was met. The repair has not been reopened within 30 days. My complaint was closed as "Duplicate", as it was linked with BMC25-000720 and BMC25-000722.

I would like to bring one thing to your attention. Western Express Highway has had 29 repair jobs, of which 7 failed, with about Rs 20.75 lakh spent. Cold mix patches may not be the lasting answer here.

I request that you:
1. Inspect the Marol patch and confirm it is holding.
2. Review whether a more durable repair is possible for this stretch.
3. Reply to me with the findings by 15 July 2025.

Thank you for your time.

Yours sincerely,
[Name]
[Phone]
